cards.name: Fast Blur In
cards.summary: The clip starts heavily blurred (Fast Blur Blurriness 127) and sharpens to clear over its first second.
use_for: blur-to-sharp opening of a documentary scene or chapter
soft reveal of a press photo or headline before a Ken Burns move
reel hook: compress the keyframes to ~0.3 s so a blurred frame snaps into focus on the beat
avoid: The preset leaves Repeat Edge Pixels off, so frame edges go dark/transparent while blurred; switch it on
Blurriness is in pixels: 127 is total mush at 720p but only heavy at 4K; scale it to the resolution
Fast Blur is a legacy-style effect; Premiere 2026's new Gaussian Blur (Amount 0-100, not pixels) is the modern alternative if you need its extra controls
cards.scripting: Premiere's scripting API cannot apply .prfpset presets by name. Rebuild: add Fast Blur (AE.ADBE Fast Blur) and set {"Blurriness": [[0, 127], [1, 0]], "Blur Dimensions": 0, "Repeat Edge Pixels": true}. Preset type 'Anchor to In Point' (stored Type 1): keyframes sit in the clip's first second; recipe times are seconds from the clip start. Stored values: Blurriness keyframes 127 -> 0 one second apart, Blur Dimensions 0 (Horizontal and Vertical), and an unnamed checkbox = false that maps to Repeat Edge Pixels; the recipe turns Repeat Edge Pixels on to avoid dark edges (set it false to match the preset exactly).

cards.name: PiP 25% LL
cards.summary: Static 25%-scale picture-in-picture (480x270 at 1080p: a quarter of the width, 1/16 of the frame area): the clip is scaled to 25% and parked in the lower-left quarter of the frame, roughly centred in it (box spans x 287-767, y 677-947 px at 1920x1080: ~285 px in from the side, ~135 px from the bottom), with the track below showing around it.
use_for: reporter / anchor box over full-frame B-roll in a news explainer
show the original source clip in the corner while the narrator comments on it (reaction / commentary reels)
two-up comparison: pair with the opposite corner preset for then-vs-now or leader-vs-leader
small screen-recording inset in AI-tool explainers
avoid: Not a tight corner box: it sits well in from the edges. For a news-style corner box with ~48 px margins use Position [0.15, 0.83] instead
Scale 25 is relative to the SOURCE size: a 4K clip in a 1080p sequence at Scale 25 is half-frame, not quarter. Fit the clip to the frame first (scale = 25 x fit scale)
A bare inset with no border or shadow blends into busy B-roll and reads amateur; add Drop Shadow or Stroke

In a 9:16 reel sequence a 16:9 clip at Scale 25 is a tiny 480x270 box (under half the frame width); use Scale 40-50 there; the lower boxes also reach into the caption/UI band at the bottom of the reel
